match.reason: None of the bank points teaches Newton's first law: the circular motion, gravitation and projectile cards all rely on the net-force idea rather than stating that an object keeps its velocity unless a net force acts.

draft.title: Newton's first law
card: Newton's first law says an object keeps its velocity unless a net force acts on it. The net force is the sum of all the forces on the object.
If the net force is zero, an object at rest stays at rest. An object that is moving keeps moving in a straight line at the same speed.
So an object moving at constant velocity has a net force of zero. Several forces can still act on it, as long as they balance.
A net force is needed to change the velocity, which means to speed up, slow down or turn. Motion alone does not need a net force.
draft.remember: No net force means no change in velocity. Constant velocity does not need a net force.

a.q: A skydiver falls at a constant velocity of 55 m/s straight down. What is the net force on the skydiver?
opts: Zero, because the forces on the skydiver balance
Downwards, because the skydiver is moving down
Downwards, because gravity is acting on the skydiver
Upwards, because air resistance acts on the skydiver
a.why: Constant velocity means the velocity is not changing, so the net force is zero. Gravity and air resistance both act, but they balance. The motion downwards does not need a net force downwards.

b.q: Priya pushes a trolley along a flat, straight corridor at a steady 1.5 m/s. Which statement about the forces on the trolley is correct?
opts: Her push is balanced by the forces resisting the motion
Her push is larger than the forces resisting the motion
Her push is the only force acting along the corridor
Her push is needed to cancel the trolley's weight
b.why: A steady velocity means the net force is zero, so her push must be balanced by friction and other resisting forces along the corridor. A larger push would make the trolley speed up. Weight acts downwards and is balanced by a different force.
b.clue: Steady speed in a straight line means what for the net force?

a.best: Zero, because the forces on the skydiver balance

b.best: Her push is balanced by the forces resisting the motion
